name: Split pivot — floating shock
note: Split pivot with a floating shock. Body A is the chainstay: it pivots at the bottom bracket (MP) and carries the rear axle, with FP exactly on the axle, and also carries the shock lower eye SG on an extension ahead of MP. Body C is the seat stay, running from the axle (FP) up to LP. Body R is the rocker: it pivots on a bracket on the front of the seat tube (SP, at least 25mm ahead of it) and carries LP and the shock upper eye SE. The shock stands wholly in front of the seat tube and above the down tube, and crosses neither tube. Known limit: in this layout the seat stay and the chainstay extension both pass across the seat tube (the checker does not test link-to-tube crossings), so the seat tube would need a clearance or a different route before it can be built.
